info.title: Zscaler Private Access
info.description:
Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) API provides programmatic access to ZPA's core Zero Trust Network Access configuration objects: application segments, segment groups, server groups, App Connectors and App Connector Groups, and access policy rules.

Authentication: OAuth2 client-credentials via Zscaler's unified OneAPI platform (brokered through Zidentity). Requires OneAPI access to be enabled for your organization by your Zscaler account team -- it is not self-service. Generate a client ID/secret at Admin Portal > API Key Management > OneAPI Credentials.

This spec was built directly from Zscaler's official, actively-maintained zscaler-sdk-go source (github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-go) -- endpoint paths, HTTP verbs, and field-level request/response schemas were extracted from the SDK's typed Go structs and service functions.

Source: https://github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-go/tree/master/zscaler/zpa/services
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to ZPA's most commonly automated policy/config areas rather than its full 100+ service surface: Application Segments, Segment Groups, Server Groups, App Connectors & App Connector Groups, and Access Policy rules -- 31 operations, all traced to real endpoint constants and typed request/response structs in Zscaler's official SDK. Excludes Service Edges/Service Edge Groups, provisioning keys, application servers, SAML/SCIM/IdP configuration, device posture and trusted network reference data, browser access/PRA/inspection/isolation policy types, and dozens of other more specialized ZPA service areas -- see the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

oneApiOAuth2.description: OneAPI OAuth2 client-credentials flow via Zidentity. Token URL uses your organization's vanity domain: https://<vanityDomain>.zslogin.net/oauth2/v1/token. The token request also requires a fixed audience parameter (audience=https://api.zscaler.com) alongside client_id/client_secret -- configure this as an extra static token-request parameter on the integration if your platform version supports it.
